description: A Windows .NET MAUI build started failing after a Visual Studio update with duplicate WebView2 types from generated WinRT source, based on https://github.com/dotnet/maui/issues/25160.
prompt: After updating VS 2022 to 17.11.5, the Windows target of our MAUI app stopped compiling. We do not directly use WebView2, but the build now repeats: `error CS0433: The type 'CoreWebView2' exists in both 'Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Core, Version=1.0.864.35' and 'Microsoft.WinUI, Version=3.0.0.0'` from `obj\Debug\net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0\win10-x64\intermediatexaml\WinRT.SourceGenerator\Generator.RcwReflectionFallbackGenerator\RcwFallbackInitializer.g.cs`.
